# The problem

What you are trying to do that the current package does not let you do.

# Proposed change

A specific description of the new behaviour. If you have an API shape in mind, sketch it.

# Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or different designs you considered.

# Cross-language context

If the upstream Python `edgar-design` already supports this, link to the relevant documentation at https://rotsl.github.io/edgar/.
